youtube.baslik: Is sign language the same all over the world? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Turkish Sign Language, or TID, is a full visual language with its own vocabulary and grammar. Signs are not made of handshapes alone; the location and movement of the hand and where the sign is placed in space also carry meaning, and facial expressions such as eyebrow and head movements carry grammatical information, such as questions or negation. Sign languages are not universal; Turkish Sign Language and American Sign Language are different languages.
